name: Royalty Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single large residence with a gray shingle roof and an irregular multi-gable footprint|A paved driveway leads from the street to the front of the house|A curved walkway connects the driveway to a covered entry|Mature trees stand close to the building on several sides|A sidewalk runs along the street frontage|Neighboring homes sit on adjacent lots.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence faces the street, with a paved driveway, a sidewalk, and a curved walkway to a covered entry|The house has a gray multi-gable roof|Dense mature trees frame both sides of the facade and stand close to the roof|A small lawn sits between the walkway and the street|Neighboring homes are not in this frame.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side roof planes and the side wall, with dense mature trees standing close to the building|The paved driveway and sidewalk remain visible toward the street|Limited openings are visible through the tree cover|Neighboring lots sit close along this side.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows a two-level wall, with a light upper level and a darker lower level, and several windows|Dense mature trees stand close to the roof and the side walls|Neighboring roofs are visible beyond the rear of the lot|No open rear yard is visible through the tree cover.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side wall, windows, and gray roof planes, with mature trees standing close to the structure|The paved driveway and sidewalk remain at the street edge|Tree cover limits the view of the ground along this side|Neighboring homes sit on adjacent lots.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from High Lakes Loop to the front of the house. The site is a large single-family home on a residential loop, with neighboring houses close on several sides. Side yards are narrow and heavily treed. Mature trees stand close to the roof and may limit sightlines and movement around the sides and rear. No gates are visible from the imagery. Open ground beyond the neighborhood is visible to the southeast of the block.
clarifications: Does the driveway end at the front entry, or does it continue to a garage? Are there any gates or fences controlling side or rear access? Is there a usable path around the house for pedestrian or equipment movement through the trees? Are there additional entries on the rear or sides that are not visible through the tree cover?
